input.quote: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
input.rationale: Structurally Section 21 is acceptable: the cap is expressly mutual (21.1), the exclusion of indirect and consequential damages is mutual (21.2), and "Excluded Claims" (21.3) carves out confidentiality, data-protection and security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement. The failure is the cap base: "Fees" is defined at 1.5 as only the "Implementation Fee", fixed by 1.6 as a one-time USD 12,000 charge in the first Order Form, and 21.1 further narrows it to that first Order Form, so recurring subscription and services charges fall outside the base and the cap is an illusory USD 12,000 — below the six-month floor and in walk-away territory. The same narrow "Fees" term also hollows out 21.3's statement that Customer's payment obligation is not damages. The redline resets the cap basis to the greater of the fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000, and widens 21.3's payment carve-out to amounts due under this Agreement, leaving mutuality, the damages exclusion and every carve-out untouched.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] "Fees" is defined as only the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form, so the cap is illusory; we have reset limb (a) to the fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement in the 12 months preceding the claim and added the USD 1,000,000 limb. In 21.3 we widen the payment carve-out to amounts due under this Agreement so Customer's payment obligations, not just the Implementation Fee, sit outside the cap.
proposal.summary: Reset 21.1 cap basis to the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000, and widen 21.3's payment carve-out to amounts due
